scope: Read-only source and saved-log review; no ROS/CAN/hardware commands, no source or timing/TTL changes.
conclusions: No stale-metadata bug found in the unchanged-occupancy path: a real coherent fusion updates last_occ_update_time; identical occupancy advances the ESDF observation sequence; Complete snapshots receive the new fusion metadata while reusing immutable distance values.
Exporter header[3] is set from the pinned Complete fusion time on every sample. Only distance storage/header[17] are reused when the distance version is unchanged.

Independent 50ms sample/output timers can add phase waiting. A repeated one-period delay is a plausible mechanism, not proven by the available logs; no timer change is justified from this review alone.
The current pipeline log cannot decompose total fusion-to-MPPI delay. No TTL increase or replacement of source timestamps with current publication time is proposed.

source_evidence.fact: Real coherent occupancy fusion records last_occ_update_time.
Unchanged binary occupancy advances esdf_observation_seq and reuses distances.
ReadSnapshot copies observation/esdf/fusion metadata every publication; shared distance values depend on distance revision.
header[3] uses the pinned map fusion source time.
Distance reuse does not suppress header[3] metadata refresh.
50ms sample timer shares the serialized map queue; 50ms output timer uses its existing separate queue/spinner.
Pipeline result age is measured before commit and after worker result receipt; it excludes commit, immutable read-snapshot publication, exporter and receiver costs.

limits: The three rows are rolling summary windows, not per-generation synchronized traces.
snapshot_avg in pipeline means occupancy-job capture, not exported ESDF copy or network delay.
header[17] is field-copy acquisition, not a send timestamp; reception minus header[17] combines several stages.
Source-copy publication, exporter sample/send and receiver decode timing are not individually recorded here.
